Hello to all,
My name is Ariel, im a phd candidate and will TA a systematics course over th enext semester. one of our exercises will involve giving students a simple script and they will use geomorph to digitize LM and do some simple analysis and visualization.

when i run the code i have 2 curious problems. 
the first, iwhen using digitize2d to mark LM's the markings (in Rstudio) dont mark the coordinates. instead they are offset. they do seem to be in the right relative position to eachother but not to the image itself.

the second, when i attempt to display the coordinates (i.e plotRefToTarget) they appear 90 degrees rotated clockwise.

how can i solve this?

also, if someone can share a most generic script for digitizing LM's, and some analysis and visualization that i could compare to would be greatly appreciated

Thx in advance

Ariel BLV

messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] Landmark rotation and mismatch
parts:
Ariel,


Not sure about the first issue. I would need a reproducible example.

 

As to the second, plotRefToTarget is typically used post superimposition to display the differences of one specimen relative to the reference. From your email, it is not clear how you were using it, but if performed on specimens prior to GPA, they would of course have positional and orientational differences in them. That may be what you are viewing.


Dean
